description: Save an email design as a reusable template in the user's Send16 workspace. Use this when the user has designed an email (for example in a Claude artifact) and wants it in Send16. Pass the complete email HTML. Send16 hosts every image (remote URLs and inline data: images), converts merge tags like {{first_name}} to Send16's format, and stores the HTML exactly as designed. For best results across Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail the HTML should be email-safe: table-based layout around 600px wide, inline styles, PNG/JPG/GIF images in tags (not SVG or CSS backgrounds), web-safe font fallbacks, and alt text on images. Returns the template id; follow up with send_template_test to send a preview.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

category.description: Library category, e.g. newsletter, onboarding, announcement, ecommerce, transactional. Defaults to custom.

convertMergeTags.description: Convert common merge tags ({{first_name}}, *|FNAME|*) to Send16 tags (default true)

description.description: Short description shown in the template library

hostImages.description: Copy every image onto Send16 hosting so it can't break later (default true)

html.description: The complete email HTML (a full <html> document or a body fragment)

mode.description: hybrid (default): keep the exact HTML, convertible to editable blocks later. html: exact HTML only. blocks: convert to editable builder blocks now (lossy for complex designs).

name: save_template
